desc: The CobraTec Monarch liner-lock folding knife is strong and decisive with a sharp drop point satin D2 blade. Ergonomic knife handle that features a lightweight textured G-10 scale with lanyard hole that feels great in your hand. Very smooth opening knife with ball bearing in the pivot that allows for smooth operation. The tip up clip is made for right hand or left hand use. The Monarch was made for everyday use.
